name: motion_demo
description: v11.4 example: generic motion-library clips (not one game's move list) plus a character type. Copy this file and change the moves for a fighter, a sport, a platformer or anything else. lib:punch means the shared-skeleton library, not the procedural pose of the same name.
notes: Swap character_type for heavy_brawler, keeper, playmaker, big_boss, small_agile, or a JSON file of your own.
